Hi Dean,

I ran gl2vcf without problems on a PC and on a Mac using the stable version of plink (see code below).  However, I could not replicate the error you described.

> devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@dev")
> library(dartR)
> gl2vcf(platypus.gl,
       snp_pos='ChromPos_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1',
       snp_chr = 'Chrom_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1',
       outpath = getwd())

Note that “snp_pop" is the field name from the slot "loc.metrics" where the SNP position is stored and “snp_chr" is the field name from the slot "loc.metrics" where the chromosome of each is stored.

Could you please try the code above, if you still have problems, please send me your dataset to my personal e-mail: luis.mijangos at gmail.com.

Cheers,
Luis

On Friday, 2 June 2023 at 8:10:02 am UTC+10 neutro...@gmail.com wrote:
Hi. DartR is awesome. Keep up the good work.

However, I've found that the gl2vcf() function which worked previously on v2.0.4 is not working as before with v2.7.2 or 'flavour=dev' (v2.9.?).

I'm converting dartr created genlight (gl) to VCF and previously the gl@chromosome names would be exported to the VCF file (see screen shot and code below). However, this has stopped working.

I've tested with gl's created with dartr V2.0.4, v2.7.2, and the dev version. All of them create a gl with gl@chromosome field populated correctly. I've tested with several plink versions and plink_win64_20220402 works as expected with dartr v2.0.4 and producues a VCF with contig/chrom names populated appropriately (see attached pic left panel). When a gl is created with dartr v2.7.2 but then using gl2vcf() with v2.0.4 and plink_win64_20220402 this again works correctly. So its not dartr v2.7.2 upstream functions causing the problem.

However, using dartr 2.7.2 and the dev version with plink_win64_20220402, the chrom names are not transfered to the VCF. See the attached WinMere screenshot comparing two VCF files. On the left the contig & chrom names are populated correctly (using v2.04. &  plink_win64_20220402). On the right the same fields are not populated correctly (using v2.72 and  plink_win64_20220402).

Weirdly, even with v2.0.4 and two linux plink versions (plink_linux_x86_64_20220402 & plink_linux_x86_64_20230116) I get the same problem.

I'll  continue using dartr v2.0.4 version until this is fixed but it would be great to have this working again in the new versions. I havent posted my raw data because I dont want it public but I can send it privately if you cant recreate the problem at your end.

Thanks for all the gerat work you do.

Cheers,
Dean
